item.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade kicks off after being postponed
item.description: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is kicking off in New York City Saturday morning after it was postponed for the first time in its 100-year history.

item.title: What to know about the weather-delayed 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
item.description: The 100th annual Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade will take place Saturday morning.

item.title: Iowa detonation did not increase levels of lead in water, EPA says
item.description: The EPA conducted sampling at more than 130 structures in Iowa, including homes, schools, daycare centers and churches.

item.title: U.S. Air Force cloud platform breached by hackers, report says
item.description: The alleged incident follows a series of breaches and outages that have been reported at federal agencies this month.
